exposure: Ramadan fasting during pregnancy (more than 15 days)
cohort: 226 women aged 18-35 years, with gestational amenorrhea of 15-40 weeks, attending the labor room at Nishtar Hospital, Multan, between May and October 2019.
finding: No significant differences were found in maternal or perinatal outcomes between women who fasted for more than 15 days during Ramadan and those who did not fast or fasted for less than 15 days.
